dataset_published_cutoff_note: Cutoff documented by source README; dataset may be updated later.
selection_method: training-set matches prioritized, then latest complete eligible markets, stable by ID
filters: exclude validation/test identifiers and questions when ZIP provided
text_preprocessing: Unicode NFKC; whitespace collapse; Question: {q} | Event: {title} if title is present
pooling: attention-masked mean over last hidden states
statistics_population: returned top_k matches that meet threshold
resolution_time_limitation: end_date is not a verified actual settlement timestamp
as_of_volume_limitation: Latest dataset volume is not a reconstructable historical volume-as-of earlier cutoff; use a contemporaneous snapshot for earlier tests.
